subtitulo: Two of them start before you open your mouth, because both turn on a word you might use — a region called Macedonia, and a set of sculptures with two names
cena: Someone has just told you where they stand, with feeling, and left a gap where your opinion is supposed to go.
frasePiso: Name the city, use the descriptive term, ask how it looks from here. A question keeps you at the table; a verdict ends the evening.

fatosDatados.afirmacao: The Interim Accord between Greece and its northern neighbour dates from 13 September 1995. On 5 December 2011 the International Court of Justice, in case number 142, held that Greece had breached article 11(1) of that Accord by objecting to the neighbour's admission to NATO at Bucharest in 2008, and declared that the finding itself constituted adequate satisfaction. The Prespa Agreement was signed on 17 June 2018 at Psarades and entered into force on 12 February 2019, the Greek Parliament having approved it on 25 January 2019 by 153 votes. It fixes the constitutional name «Republic of North Macedonia» for all purposes, erga omnes, with the nationality given as «Macedonian/citizen of the Republic of North Macedonia» and the official language designated «Macedonian language». Whether the agreement was good, fair or legitimate is disputed inside both countries, for opposite reasons, and is a position rather than a fact — as is any claim about to whom the name, the history or Alexander belongs. What a visitor needs is narrower: Μακεδονία is also the name of a Greek region, whose capital is Thessaloniki, so the English word is ambiguous.
fatosDatados.fonte: Acordo Interino de 13.09.1995; CIJ, caso nº 142, acórdão de 05.12.2011; Acordo de Prespa, assinado 17.06.2018 em Ψαράδες, em vigor desde 12.02.2019 (aprovação parlamentar grega em 25.01.2019, 153 votos)

fatosDatados.afirmacao: Section 3 of the British Museum Act 1963 severely restricts disposal from the collection — broadly to duplicates, items damaged beyond repair, forgeries and objects unnecessary for study — so a definitive return of the Parthenon Sculptures would require new legislation. The museum's own De-accession Policy of November 2018 restates the position. In November 2025 the Greek Prime Minister described the talks as at an impasse, saying they had produced only an offer of a loan, a formula Greece rejects. At the 25th session of the UNESCO Intergovernmental Committee for Promoting the Return of Cultural Property, twenty countries formally supported the Greek request. Whether removal was theft or rescue, whether the Ottoman firman authorised it, and whether return would set a precedent are positions rather than facts. The operational point is about vocabulary: «Elgin Marbles» and «Parthenon Marbles» already signal a side, and «Parthenon Sculptures» is the neutral descriptive term.
fatosDatados.fonte: British Museum Act 1963, secção 3; British Museum, «De-accession Policy», nov/2018; declaração de impasse do primeiro-ministro grego, nov/2025 (GreekReporter, 19.11.2025); 25ª sessão do Comité da UNESCO para o Retorno de Bens Culturais

steps.pt: Two arguments here start before you open your mouth, because both of them turn on a word you might use.
The first is a name. Macedonia is a region of Greece, with Thessaloniki as its capital.
It is also, since 2019, part of a neighbouring country's constitutional name, agreed and in force.

steps.acao: He is telling you where you are standing, not asking you to take a view. Take the geography.
steps.es: Η Μακεδονία είναι εδώ. Πρωτεύουσα η Θεσσαλονίκη.
steps.pt: Macedonia is here. Thessaloniki is the capital.
steps.tts: Η Μακεδονία είναι εδώ. Πρωτεύουσα η Θεσσαλονίκη.

steps.pt: So I'm going to Macedonia can mean two opposite things. Name the city instead and it stops being a puzzle.

steps.promptPt: You are telling the man at the ticket desk where the rest of your week goes. Give him the city, not the region. Speak now.
steps.pt: I'm going to Thessaloniki.

steps.promptPt: You are about to repeat a name you have only ever read in English, and you would rather borrow theirs first. Speak now.
steps.pt: How do you say it?
The second is the sculptures. What is documented is the law and the state of the talks.
A 1963 Act limits what the British Museum may give away, so a return would need new legislation.
In November 2025 the talks were called an impasse: a loan was offered, and a loan is not what is asked for.
Whether that should change is a position, and the term you pick already announces one before you argue.

steps.acao: That is a tease aimed at your accent, not an accusation. Hand it back with something you did.
steps.es: Α, από την Αγγλία! Πες μας για τα Γλυπτά, λοιπόν.
steps.pt: Ah, from England! Go on then, tell us about the Sculptures.
steps.tts: Α, από την Αγγλία! Πες μας για τα Γλυπτά, λοιπόν.

steps.promptPt: The table is waiting, still smiling. Answer with your own morning at the museum rather than with a position. Speak now.
steps.pt: I saw the Parthenon Sculptures.
Then there are the ordinary ones — city against city, mainland against islands. Same rule, lighter stakes.

steps.acao: An old family argument, opened for your entertainment. Enjoy it and stay out of the scoring.
steps.es: Στη Θεσσαλονίκη τρώνε καλύτερα. Μην το πεις σε Αθηναίο όμως!
steps.pt: They eat better in Thessaloniki. Don't say that to anyone from Athens, though!
steps.tts: Στη Θεσσαλονίκη τρώνε καλύτερα. Μην το πεις σε Αθηναίο όμως!

steps.pt: The move is always the same. Ask how it looks from here, and never hand down a verdict of your own.

steps.promptPt: He has given you a strong opinion and stopped. Put the floor back in his hands instead of matching him. Speak now.
steps.pt: How do you see it?

steps.promptPt: The whole table has turned to you for a ruling on something they have argued about since before you were born. Say honestly where you stand on it. Speak now.
steps.es: Δεν ξέρω αρκετά για να κρίνω.
steps.pinyin: dhen KSE-ro ar-ke-TA ya na KRI-no
steps.pt: I don't know enough to judge.
steps.tts: Δεν ξέρω αρκετά για να κρίνω.

steps.pt: Saying you do not know enough is not a dodge. After three weeks in a country it is simply accurate.

steps.promptPt: They press you anyway, cheerfully, glasses in hand. Choose the chair you actually want at this table. Speak now.
steps.pt: I'd rather listen.

steps.acao: Declining the ruling reads as respect, not as evasion. The conversation carries on around you.
steps.es: Καλά κάνεις. Ούτε εμείς συμφωνούμε μεταξύ μας.
steps.pt: Quite right. We don't agree among ourselves either.
steps.tts: Καλά κάνεις. Ούτε εμείς συμφωνούμε μεταξύ μας.

steps.promptPt: You walked into something without meaning to and the temperature moved. Name that plainly and let it pass. Speak now.
steps.es: Δεν ήξερα ότι είναι ευαίσθητο θέμα.
steps.pinyin: dhen IK-se-ra O-ti I-ne ev-E-sthi-to THE-ma
steps.pt: I didn't know it was a sensitive subject.
steps.tts: Δεν ήξερα ότι είναι ευαίσθητο θέμα.

steps.promptPt: Move the conversation from the national argument, where you have no standing, to the town outside the window. Speak now.
steps.es: Τι άλλαξε εδώ τα τελευταία χρόνια;
steps.pinyin: ti A-la-kse e-DHO ta te-lef-TE-a HRO-nya
steps.pt: What's changed here in the last few years?
steps.tts: Τι άλλαξε εδώ τα τελευταία χρόνια;

steps.promptPt: Turn the whole thing into something useful to you: the four people arguing all know the coast better than any map. Speak now.
steps.pt: Where should I go next?

steps.es: Δεν ξέρω αρκετά για να κρίνω. Προτιμώ να ακούω. Πού να πάω μετά;
steps.pinyin: dhen KSE-ro ar-ke-TA ya na KRI-no · pro-ti-MO na a-KU-o · PU na PA-o me-TA
steps.pt: Shadow the three that decline the ruling and keep the evening moving.
steps.tts: Δεν ξέρω αρκετά για να κρίνω. Προτιμώ να ακούω. Πού να πάω μετά;

steps.pt: A04 done. Name the city, use the descriptive term, ask the question and leave the ruling alone.

aprofundar.titulo: Two words that place you, and one question that does not

secoes.titulo: A name that points at two places
secoes.corpo: Μακεδονία is the name of a region of northern Greece, whose capital is Thessaloniki, and it is also part of the constitutional name of the country next door. That second use is settled in law and in force: the Prespa Agreement was signed on 17 June 2018 at Psarades, approved by the Greek Parliament on 25 January 2019 by 153 votes and in force from 12 February 2019, fixing «Republic of North Macedonia» for all purposes. Behind it sits the Interim Accord of 13 September 1995 and the judgment of the International Court of Justice of 5 December 2011, in case 142, which held that Greece had breached article 11(1) by objecting to the neighbour's NATO admission at Bucharest in 2008 and treated that finding as satisfaction in itself. Those are dates. Whether the agreement was good, fair or legitimate is argued inside both countries, for opposite reasons, and so is any claim about who the name, the history or Alexander belongs to. None of that is your business as a visitor, and none of it needs to be.

secoes.titulo: Name the city and the problem stops existing
secoes.corpo: An English sentence beginning I'm going to Macedonia can land in two opposite ways at the same table, and no amount of goodwill fixes it after the fact. The cheap repair is to be specific: Thessaloniki, Kavala, Ohrid, Skopje. A city name is unambiguous, it is what you actually mean, and it never once reads as a position. Πώς το λέτε εσείς does the same job in reverse — you borrow their word for the place before you use yours.

secoes.titulo: The sculptures, and the two names for them
secoes.corpo: What is documented is narrow and worth knowing. Section 3 of the British Museum Act 1963 restricts disposal from the collection to a short list — duplicates, irreparably damaged items, forgeries, objects unnecessary for study — so a definitive return would need new legislation, a position the museum's own de-accession policy of November 2018 restates. In November 2025 the Greek Prime Minister called the talks an impasse, saying they had produced only the offer of a loan, which Greece rejects. At the 25th session of the UNESCO committee on the return of cultural property, twenty countries formally supported the Greek request. Everything else — theft or rescue, what the firman authorised, whether a return sets a precedent — is a position. And the naming matters more than the argument: «Elgin Marbles» and «Parthenon Marbles» both signal a side, and «Parthenon Sculptures» is the descriptive term that does not.

secoes.titulo: The lighter versions, which run constantly
secoes.corpo: One city against another, the mainland against the islands, the capital against everywhere else: these run all day and are largely affectionate. They still work the same way. Being asked for a verdict is hospitality, like being passed the bread, and it carries no obligation to answer. Δεν ξέρω αρκετά για να κρίνω and προτιμώ να ακούω are short, they get a nod rather than a groan, and they cost you nothing at all.

Τι άλλαξε εδώ τα τελευταία χρόνια moves the conversation from the national argument, where you have no standing, to the local one, where the person in front of you is the only available expert. Πού να πάω μετά does something better still: it converts four people mid-argument into four people planning your week. Both are questions, neither is a ruling, and both leave you better informed than the position you did not give.

permissao: You are allowed to have no opinion and to say so in one sentence. Δεν ξέρω αρκετά για να κρίνω is not a dodge here — after three weeks in a country it is the accurate answer, and it is heard as respect rather than as reticence. You are also allowed to have walked into something without knowing: δεν ήξερα ότι είναι ευαίσθητο θέμα closes it cleanly, and nobody holds a first mistake against a guest who names it.
espelho: Every country has the argument outsiders should stay out of, and everyone has watched a visitor settle theirs confidently over dinner. You already know exactly how that looks from the inside, which is the only qualification this part requires.

fichasCulturais.sinal: You say in English that you are going to Macedonia, and the room goes quiet for a beat before someone asks which one.
fichasCulturais.suaLeitura: I have said something offensive, or stumbled into politics I know nothing about.
fichasCulturais.oQueEAli: The word points at two places. Μακεδονία is a region of northern Greece with Thessaloniki as its capital, and it is also part of the constitutional name of the country next door, fixed by the Prespa Agreement in force since 12 February 2019. The pause is ambiguity, not offence.
fichasCulturais.oQueVoceFaz: Name the city — Thessaloniki, Kavala, Skopje, Ohrid — rather than the region or the country. If you want their word for a place before you use it, ask πώς το λέτε εσείς.
fichasCulturais.oQueMelhora: You say what you actually meant on the first try, and you never accidentally announce a position on an agreement you have not read.
fichasCulturais.ondeNaoVale: Not a reason to avoid the word altogether or to whisper it. It is an ordinary Greek place name printed on road signs, football shirts and jars of honey — the ambiguity is in the English sentence, not in the region.

fichasCulturais.sinal: Somebody hears your accent, grins, and asks you about the sculptures as though you personally had them in a cupboard.
fichasCulturais.suaLeitura: I am being blamed, and I should either apologise or defend my country.
fichasCulturais.oQueEAli: It is a tease with a real subject behind it. What is documented is the legal position — section 3 of the British Museum Act 1963 restricts disposal, so a return would need new legislation — and the state of the talks, called an impasse in November 2025 after only a loan was offered. Whether return is right is a position, held on both sides and inside both countries.
fichasCulturais.oQueVoceFaz: Answer with what you did rather than what you think: είδα τα Γλυπτά του Παρθενώνα. Use «Parthenon Sculptures» — the other two names announce a side — and if you are asked to rule, say you do not know enough.
fichasCulturais.oQueMelhora: You stay a person who visited a museum instead of becoming a delegate for a country, and the conversation usually turns into something far more interesting about the building itself.
fichasCulturais.ondeNaoVale: Not a reason to treat the subject as forbidden. Plenty of people will raise it happily and enjoy talking about it — what you are declining is the verdict, not the topic, and refusing to discuss it at all reads as stranger than joining in.
